description: This file defines a model class `RasaWebhookRequest` for representing requests sent to a Rasa REST webhook API, including properties for message content and an optional sender identifier, along with a method to serialize the object to JSON.

classes.name: RasaWebhookRequest
classes.description: A data model class representing a request to the Rasa webhook API, encapsulating message text and optionally a sender identifier, with serialization support.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the `RasaWebhookRequest` instance into a JSON-compatible map, including the message and optionally the sender ID.
